_schema: one JSON object per line, append-only, never edit/delete a past line (append a follow-up line instead). Fields: date (ISO date/time you wrote this line), session_label (best-known name/id -- these are KNOWN TO BE UNSTABLE across reconnects, don't treat as a durable identity; a distinctive free-text task description is more useful for matching lines to a real session than the label), status (active | wrapped | unknown), touching (list of files/scripts/VMs/Kaggle-kernels you're working on right now -- this is the collision-avoidance field, keep it accurate), summary (one line, what you're doing/did), handoff_doc (path, if you wrote one), note (anything else worth a future session knowing, optional). Read via `tail -N`, not by loading the whole file -- it's meant to grow indefinitely and stay cheap to check.
